description: [Tauri Apps Only] Manage Tauri windows. Actions: "list" - List all windows with labels, titles, URLs, and state. "info" - Get detailed info for a window (size, position, title, focus, visibility). "resize" - Resize a window (requires width/height, uses logical pixels by default). Requires active driver_session. For browser windows, use Chrome DevTools MCP instead.

action.description: Action: "list" all windows, get "info" for one window, or "resize" a window

appIdentifier.description: App port or bundle ID to target. Defaults to the only connected app or the default app if multiple are connected.

logical.description: Use logical pixels (true, default) or physical pixels (false). Only for "resize"

windowId.description: Window label to target (defaults to "main"). Required for "info", optional for "resize"

name: manage_window
